newsitem.title: USA: NY conditionally OKs Bell Atlantic /NYNEX.
newsitem.headline: NY conditionally OKs Bell Atlantic /NYNEX.

text.p: The New York State Public Service Commmision voted to approve the merger of NYNEX Corp and Bell Atlantic Corp -- subject to a long list of conditions to which the companies must agree within 10 days.
The three members of the New York State utility regulation commission voted unamiously in a 15-minute meeting held Thursday at the board's offices in Albany, the state capitol.

Among the conditions included in the qualified approval was a demand that the combined company hire 750 to 1,000 new support staff by the end of 1997 to shore up customer service for New York state local phone service customers.
"There is no (immediate) rate reduction. We have attached conditions that we believe will bring rate reduction," Commission Chairman John O'Mara told Reuters in an interview following the decision.
"This is a step deal. We can't do everything at once," said Eugene Zeltmann, a member of the state regulatory commission, of conditions the companies must meet over time.

Other qualifications set by the N.Y. State Public Service Commission (NYPSC) include a requirement that the combined company not relocate any major business functions existing inside New York state prior to the merger.
